description: Season-aware conference-membership windows per programme (institution_slug x gender), 2016-2026. Authored from official GAC/MIAA, LSC, GSC, GLVC, RMAC, SSC, NE10, CACC, ECC, PSAC, MEC, G-MAC, GLIAC (gliac.org), SAC (the thesac.com standings archive), Conference Carolinas (conferencecarolinas.com), Peach Belt (peachbeltconference.org), CCAA (goccaa.org), PacWest (thepacwest.com) and GNAC (the gnacsports.com standings archive) records; each window cites its source. standings_archives names, per conference code, the standings archive a conference with no per-season records pages keeps its member lists in (url_template with {id}, and the page id per season), so a source sentence can cite the page and check-membership --standings can read a captured copy of it back. Sibling in role to the generated canon.json identity map - identity and membership are separate axes (tl-ath plan gate, 2026-08-08).
